angle: Option B — Research any topic in 20 minutes
hookHeadline:
You're spending
3 hours on research.
I do it in 20 minutes.
hookSub: And I find angles you missed.
hookTTS: You're spending three hours on research. I do the same research in twenty minutes. And my angles are different from everyone else's.
agitateMain:
You're reading the
same articles
everyone else reads.
agitateBridge: Here's how to find what none of them cover →
agitateTTS: The problem is everyone reads the same articles. Your content ends up looking just like your competitors. This workflow goes deeper.

points.label: STEP 01
points.verdict: Dump your competitors in. Ask what they missed.
bullets: Find 5 competitor articles on your topic
Upload all 5 as sources in one NotebookLM notebook
Ask: what question does none of this answer?
That gap is your content angle
points.tts: Open NotebookLM. Upload five competitor articles as sources. Then ask: what question does none of this answer? That gap is your angle. It's free, just needs a Google login.

points.label: STEP 02
points.verdict: Turn the gap into a brief. Get a draft in one prompt.
bullets: Paste the gap as your topic
Prompt: 'lead with the contrarian take, no intro fluff'
points.tts: Paste that gap into Claude with one instruction: eight hundred words, no intro fluff, lead with the contrarian take. One iteration and it's done.

points.label: STEP 03
points.verdict: Verify every claim before it goes live.
bullets: Ask: flag any claim that needs a source
Fix the flagged lines. Five minutes.
points.tts: Last step — and this is the one people skip. Paste into Gemini, ask it to flag any claim that needs a source. Fix those lines. Five minutes. Now it's verified.

proofContext:
blank page → verified draft
in twenty minutes.
No subscriptions. No degree.
proofTTS: Blank page to verified draft in twenty minutes. No subscriptions, no prompt engineering degree. Just three free tools in the right order.
ctaValueProp:

ctaTTS: Save this before you forget it. I drop one of these every day.
